answer: One workable design: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because ocean only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, vault is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any walnut approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
